name: labs/madhankumar623__instruments_automation_scpi_commands
title: Programmable DC power supply (PowerSupply_Automation.py, DCsupply_1)
intro: Programmable DC power supply (PowerSupply_Automation.py, DCsupply_1), adapted from madhankumar623/instruments_automation_scpi_commands. It reads `voltage_ch2`, `current_ch2`, `voltage_ch3` and `current_ch3`; sets `voltage_setpoint_ch2`, `current_setpoint_ch2`, `output_enabled_ch2`, `voltage_setpoint_ch3` and 2 more; runs `output_off`. `output_off`: switch both controlled channel outputs of DCsupply_1 off (INST:NSEL 2;OUTP OFF and INST:NSEL 3;OUTP OFF); it takes no input and is the declared safe state. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
